newsitem.title: USA: Gore ends eight-day Asia trip.
newsitem.headline: Gore ends eight-day Asia trip.

text.p: U.S. Vice President Al Gore returned to Washington late Saturday, ending an eight-day trip to Japan, China and South Korea that he said made "tremendous progress" in improving U.S.-Sino relations.

"We made tremendous progress in lending forward momentum in our relations with China," Gore told reporters. "It is obvious in the aftermath of the visit there that the Chinese feel as we do that we have new momentum."
Gore's five-day stop in China was the highest-level visit by a U.S. official since 1989, when Chinese troops crushed pro-democracy demonstrators around Beijing's Tiananmen Square.
